name: Sugano Yasusuke
source:
A poor ronin who is happy by nature and who is also a good youkai hunter! 
Also, please don't mention about his age, he feels insecure about it. (Honestly, he's not that old.... Right sir?) He's dirty poor though, him and his sister were abandoned as children by their own parents.He's also a fisherman and also a part-time youkai-hunter, with a lot of stories to tell. Though always looking happy, Yasusuke has a dark and bloody past, that Yukio will find out soon!
